name: Database & Schema Review
purpose: Review and harden relational schemas, migrations, indexes, constraints, transactions, and query plans using EXPLAIN ANALYZE evidence and reversible zero-downtime migration discipline.
inputs: Schema dump or migration files under review with target tables, row counts, and growth rates
EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans for affected queries plus pg_stat_statements top-20 by total time
Transaction inventory: boundaries, isolation levels, retry behavior, and lock timeouts
Operational constraints: maintenance windows, backup RPO/RTO, allowed downtime in seconds
outputs: Review verdict per migration: approve, approve with conditions, or block with concrete remediation
Index and constraint DDL with plan evidence and rollback procedure
Transaction and timeout configuration changes with monitoring hooks
stop_conditions: All migrations reviewed with reversible paths, indexed hot paths, and staging rollback under 60 s
Blocking defect found (data-loss risk, irreversible DDL, unindexed hot query) requiring author rework
